long-run-atc.def: Long-run average total cost (LRATC): the lowest average total cost of producing each output when the firm can change every input, including its plant size.

economies-of-scale.def: Economies of scale: long-run average total cost falls as the firm grows. Constant returns to scale: it stays flat. Diseconomies of scale: it rises as the firm grows.

returns-to-scale.def: How output responds when every input grows by the same share. If inputs double and output more than doubles, increasing returns to scale; exactly doubles, constant; less than doubles, decreasing returns to scale.

mes.def: Minimum efficient scale: the smallest output at which long-run average total cost reaches its lowest level.
